user.title: Bridge a Telegram chat with the mesh
user.description: Messages in the Telegram chat are sent to the mesh through the selected gateway, and messages from the mesh are posted in the chat. The chat ID must be allow-listed in the Telegram bot integration first.

data_description.telegram_entry_id: Leave empty when you have a single Telegram bot.
data_description.chat_id: The ID of the group or private chat, e.g. -1001234567890. Groups have negative IDs.
data_description.channel_index: Index of the channel on the gateway (0 is the primary channel). Only used for a channel target.
data_description.node_id: Meshtastic user ID (e.g. !a1b2c3d4) or node number. Only used for a node target: messages are exchanged as direct messages with this node.

error.invalid_chat_id: The chat ID must be a number.
error.node_id_required: Enter the node to exchange direct messages with.
error.invalid_node_id: Enter a user ID like !a1b2c3d4 or a node number.

abort.already_configured: This chat is already bridged with this mesh target.
abort.no_gateway: Set up the Meshtastic integration with a gateway first.

data.prefix_telegram_sender: Prefix mesh messages with the Telegram sender's first name
data.prefix_mesh_sender: Prefix Telegram messages with the mesh node's name

data_description.long_messages: Meshtastic text messages are limited to 200 bytes including the prefix. Split sends up to 5 numbered packets.
